t: Parts A, B, and C (other than section 841 (a) thereof) of title VIII are each amended by striking out “Surgeon General” each place it appears and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”. Section 803 (b) (42 U.S.C. 296b (b)) is amended by striking out “Surgeon Gen-eral’s” and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary’s”. Section 841 (a) (42 U.S.C. 298 (a)) is amended by striking out “Surgeon General” and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary (or his delegate) ”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that substitutes "Secretary" for "Surgeon General" in title VIII, moving authority from one federal official to another. The tempting reading is that section 841(a) may concern an advisory council, but the text here only changes which federal officer is named and creates no consultation, hearing, comment process, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision by this text.
fable.s: are each amended by striking out “Surgeon General” each place it appears and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”

opus.w: This section only substitutes "Secretary" for "Surgeon General" throughout parts of title VIII. Both are federal officials, so moving authority between them stays inside the federal government. The section adds no comment period, hearing, advisory committee, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. It may look like it changes decision-making, but no one outside the federal government becomes involved.
opus.s: Section 841 (a) (42 U.S.C. 298 (a)) is amended by striking out “Surgeon General” and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary (or his delegate) ”.

qwen_chat.w: This section consists entirely of technical amendments replacing the title 'Surgeon General' with 'Secretary' in various parts of the statute. It does not establish any new procedures for consultation, public comment, or advisory committees involving non-federal parties. The change is internal to the federal government's organizational structure.
qwen_chat.s: Parts A, B, and C (other than section 841 (a) thereof) of title VIII are each amended by striking out “Surgeon General” each place it appears and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”.
